features.title: Loyalty registration
features.content:
## Public flow

User submits details on **loyalty viewer**; backend returns `registrationID`. Returning users use **CheckLoyaltyRegistration** or **CheckLoyaltyRegistrationByPhone**.

features.title: Stamps
features.content:
## Stamp card

Staff scan or admin action adds stamps; UI reflects counts from **GetLoyaltyUserStamps**.

features.title: Prizes and rewards
features.content:
## Catalog

Public prize list for viewers; authenticated user rewards for redemption flows.

features.title: Redemption verification
features.content:
## Staff tools

Confirm pick-up at counter; cancel mistaken redemptions. **GetLoyaltyRedemptions** lists activity per QR.

features.title: Registration admin
features.content:
## Moderation

Owners review pending signups; approve/reject updates registration state.

features.title: Prize CRUD (owner)
features.content:
## Configuration

Owner configures catalog with optional inactive prizes (`includeInactive` query on GetLoyaltyPrizes).

features.title: Registration detail route
features.summary: Deep link for admin scanning user QR: loyalty-program/:qrCodeId/registration/:registrationId.
features.content:
## Routing

`LoyaltyRegistrationDetailComponent` uses `data.hideLayout` for full-page scanner UX. CamelCase and PascalCase param routes exist for compatibility.

features.title: Loyalty report demo / dashboard
features.summary: LoyaltyReportDemoComponent and loyalty-program-dashboard for analytics prototypes.
features.content:
## Reports

In-repo Markdown under `loyalty-report-demo` (`LOYALTY_*.md`) describes filters and dashboard logic; align UI with backend when APIs stabilize.
